title: Doughboys versus Bob Wills: soloists, salaries and band size
summary: Parker says the Doughboys had better soloists and were salaried staff for a flour company, while Wills depended on dances and a big band. The Doughboys' largest lineup was seven pieces.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
